body:
#### PR description:

In the Phase-2 HLT menu (`HLT_75e33`), some L3 muon modules read the **offline** GEM and RPC rechit collections (`gemRecHits`, `rpcRecHits`) rather than the HLT ones (`hltGemRecHits`, `hltRpcRecHits`):

- `hltPhase2L3GlbMuon` and `hltL3MuonsPhase2L3OI` (`L3MuonProducer`): `GlbRefitterParameters.GEMRecHitLabel` was not set in the menu, so the `fillDescriptions` default `gemRecHits` was used.
- `hltPhase2L3MuonsNoID` (`MuonIdProducer`): `rpcRecHits` and `gemRecHits` were hard-coded in the constructor, so they could not be changed from the configuration.

Changes:
- `MuonIdProducer`: adds two configurable parameters, `rpcHitInputTag` and `gemHitInputTag`. Their defaults are the previous hard-coded labels, so offline and Run-3 configurations are unchanged.
- `HLT_75e33`: points the three modules above to `hltGemRecHits` / `hltRpcRecHits`.

No changes are expected in offline outputs. Phase-2 HLT muon outputs may change in jobs where the offline GEM/RPC rechits are also available. No dependencies on other PRs.

#### PR validation:

- [x] `scram b` (code-checks / code-format)
- [x] `edmPluginHelp -p MuonIdProducer` shows the new parameters with the expected defaults
- [x] Phase-2 HLT workflow (e.g. `runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt`): runs,
